title: Catch Rate
summary: Run a rescue winch at the exact speed that makes an area, a ladder end, a shadow or a water volume change at the target rate.
subject: mathematics
ncertRef: Section 6.2, Rate of Change of Quantities
concepts: Rate of change with respect to time
Similar triangles in a related rate
learningOutcome: The student can write the quantity as a function of the one that is being driven, differentiate with respect to time and find the missing rate at a given instant.

levels.title: Growing sizes
levels.adds: Baseline: dA/dt or dV/dt is the derivative of the formula times the rate of the size (Ex 6.1 Q2 to Q8, Q12; Examples 2, 3).
hints: Write the area or volume as a formula in the size, then differentiate with respect to time.
Put in the size at that instant to get a number times w.
Divide the target by that number.

levels.title: The sliding ladder
levels.adds: New: two lengths tied by Pythagoras, x² + y² = L², so their rates are tied by x·x′ + y·y′ = 0 (Ex 6.1 Q10; Misc Q2).
hints: Differentiate x² + y² = L² with respect to time.
The ladder’s length L is constant, so its rate is zero.
The rate of the other end is the ratio of the sides times w, with a sign for falling.

levels.title: Similar triangles
levels.adds: New: the relation comes from similar triangles, so first write the quantity in one variable (Ex 6.1 Q14; Examples 31, 32).
hints: Use similar triangles to relate the radius to the depth, or the shadow to the distance.
Then write the volume (or the shadow) with one variable only.
Differentiate with respect to time and put in the instant’s values.

levels.title: Running costs
levels.adds: New: marginal cost C′(x), marginal revenue R′(x) and marginal profit R′ − C′; money flows at C′(x) times the rate w (Ex 6.1 Q15, Q16, Q18).
hints: Marginal cost is the derivative C′(x), worked out at the given x.
If x grows at w per hour, C changes at C′(x)·w per hour.

misconceptions: A rate of area is just the rate of the radius times π
Both ends of a ladder move at the same speed
A shadow grows as fast as the person walks
